notes: cpu = math_info.c (single-threaded: the support from the histogram's states, the certified sums, the requests); cuda = math_info_gpu.cu (the per-cell terms and their exact 256-bit sums; device runs only); numpy = complete reconstruction from the rows per request in float64; duckdb = GROUP BY counts then the entropy sum in SQL (float64). Float baselines are checked inside the certified enclosures.
The histogram is the only pass over the rows (scans = 1); the information support and every request read the histogram's states (rows_scanned = 0). Requests cost O(1) each from the shared sums.
